description: Check whether an IP is a current Tor exit node, from the Tor Project's public bulk exit list (keyless). Exit traffic is anonymised, so an IP seen in logs may not be the true origin — a useful context signal. For a host name the first resolved IP is used. Read-only.

target.description: IP address or host name, e.g. 171.25.193.25 or example.com

name: tor_exit_check
